newsitem.title: UK: S&P affirms AAA ratings of Pearl Assurance funds.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms AAA ratings of Pearl Assurance funds.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Monday it affirmed its AAA financial strength rating of Pearl Assurance Plc's Long-term Fund and AAA claims-paying ability rating of Pearl's General Insurance Fund.
"Both ratings are based on Pearl's strategic importance to its ultimate parent, the Australian Mutual Provident Society," S&P said in a statement.
"The company's very high expense levels are a negative factor and Standard & Poor's considers that Pearl's once-excellent market position has steadily deteriorated in recent years.

"However, Standard & Poor's expects that actions already taken by management, and those in train, will lead to reductions in Pearl's cost base and a recovery of market share," the rating agency added.
"The capitalisation of both funds is outstanding," S&P said.
